quarterly_data.signal: Vistra's second-quarter 2026 earnings release states that as of Aug. 3, 2026 it had hedged approximately 100% of its expected generation volumes for 2026, approximately 94% for 2027 and approximately 72% for 2028. Adjusted EBITDA by segment for the three months ended June 30, 2026 versus 2025: Texas $311 million vs $142 million and East $642 million vs $418 million; for the six months ended June 30, 2026 versus 2025: Texas $897 million vs $632 million and East $1,443 million vs $932 million. Operating revenues were $4,017 million in the second quarter of 2026 versus $4,250 million a year earlier.
